issues.on_page: State Receipts: Other 6,039.27 (Sales Tax Fund column)
issues.issue: This is the Sales Tax Fund's only real receipt, so it is probably local option sales tax remitted by the state. The page label is 'State Receipts: Other', not a tax line, so state aid with a review note is defensible.
Assumed to be sewer collections. The page prints only 'Other'.
